description: agent.import also takes the card's own contents, for a client that holds the card in hand — a window with a dropped file — and has no path on the daemon's machine to name. Exactly one of `path` or `content` is sent; the verification, the unsigned-import refusal and the (slug, version) idempotent result are the same as for a path (AM3).
